.]]

-कः 
__1 A spurious or interpolated passage. 
__2 An additive quantity.

__1 Throwing, casting, sending, directing &c. 
__2 Spending (as time). 
__3 Omitting. 
__4 Abusing.

.]]

.]] 
__2 Landed property, land. 
__3 Place, abode, region, repository; कपटशतमयं क्षेत्रमप्रत्ययानाम् [[

.]]

.]] 
__5 An enclosed spot of ground, portion or space, superficies, circuit. 
__6 Fertile soil. 
__7 Place of origin; [[

.]]

]]; वृद्धस्तु व्याधितो वा राजा … क्षेत्रे बीजमुत्पादयेत् [[Kau.

.]] 
__9 The sphere of action, the body (regarded as the field of the working of the soul); योगिनो यं विचिन्वन्ति क्षेत्राभ्यन्तरवर्तिनम् [Page0629-2] [[

]], 2, 3. 
__10 The mind. 
__11 A house; a town. 
__12 A plane figure, as a triangle. 
__13 A diagram. 
__14 A sign of the zodiac. 
__15 (in chiromancy) A certain portion marked out on the palm; क्षेत्रं मृजां च विधिवत्कुशलोऽवलोक्य सामुद्रविद्वदति यातमनागतं च [[Bṛ.

.]] 
-Comp. 
-अंशः a degree of the ecliptic. 
-अधिदेवता the tutelary deity of any sacred piece of ground. 
-आजीवः, -करः, -कृत m. a cultivator, peasant. 
-इक्षुः N. of a corn (यवनाल- Mar. जोंधळा). 
-गणितम् geometry. 
-गत a. geometrical. °उपपत्तिः f. geometrical proof. 
-ज a. 
__1 produced in a field. 
__2 born from the body. (-जः) 1 one of the 12 kinds of sons allowed by the old Hindu Law, the offspring of a wife by a kinsman duly appointed to raise up issue to the husband; [[

]], 2. 128. 
-जात a. begotten on the wife of another. 
-ज्ञ a. 
__1 knowing places. 
__2 clever, dexterous; क्षेत्रज्ञवद्भाषसे त्वं हि धर्मान् [[

.]] (-ज्ञः) 
__1 the soul; cf. क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत [[

.]] 
__2 the Supreme Soul. 
__3 a libertine. 
__4 a husbandman. 
__5 a form of Śiva. 
__6 a witness. (-ज्ञा) a girl fifteen years old personating Durgā at a festival. 
-देवता the deity of the fields; N. of a serpent. 
-पतिः a land-owner, a landlord. 
-पदम् a place sacred to a deity; पादौ हरेः क्षेत्रपदानुसर्पणे [[

.]] 
-पालः 
__1 a man employed to guard a field. 
__2 a deity protecting fields. 
__3 an epithet of Śiva. 
-फलम् the area or superficial contents of a figure (in math.) 
-भक्तिः f. the division of a field. 
-भूमिः f. cultivated land. 
-राशिः quantity represented by geometrical figures. 
-लिप्ता a minute of the ecliptic. 
-विद् a. = क्षेत्रज्ञ q. v. (-m.) 
__1 a husbandman. 
__2 a sage, one who has spiritual knowledge; यमक्षरं क्षेत्रविदो विदुः [[

.]] 
__3 the soul; यः क्षेत्रवित्तपतया हृदि विष्वगाविः [[

.]] 
-व्यवहारः 
__1 drawing a figure in geometry. 
__2 geometrical demonstration. 
-स्थ a. residing at a sacred place.

]], 9. 53.

.]]

.]] [[Ś. 5.]]

__1 An organic disease.

.]]

__1 Conferring happiness, ease or comfort, good, beneficial, well; धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् [[

.]] 
__2 Prosperous, at ease, comfortable; विविशुस्ते वनं वीराः क्षेमं निहतकण्टकम् [[

.]] 
-मः, -मम् 
__1 Peace, happiness, ease, welfare, well-being; वितन्वति क्षेममदेवमातृकाश्चिराय तस्मिन् कुरवश्चकासति [[

.]] 
__3 Preserving, protection; आदिदेशाथ शत्रुध्नं तेषां क्षेमाय राघवः [[

.]] 
__4 Keeping what is acquired; cf. योगक्षेम; तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् [[

.]] 
__5 Final beatitude, eternal happiness. 
__6 Basis, foundation; क्षेमे तिष्ठाति घृतमुक्षमाणा [[

.]] 
__8 A star, asterism (नक्षत्र). 
-मः, -मा A kind of perfume. 
-मा An epithet of Durgā. 
-मम् N. of one of the seven वर्षाs in Jambu-dvīpa. शिवं यवसं सुभद्रं शान्तं क्षेमममृतमभयमिति वर्षाणि [[

.]] 
-Comp.

.]]
